item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 09/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine and very hot weather to southern China in the next few days. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will affect the southern part of the South China Sea and the vicinity of the Philippines. The trough of low pressure is expected to edge closer to the northern part of the South China Sea gradually in the latter part of next week and bring showers to the region.
